title: Ask for clarification without blocking work
summary: Viết câu hỏi làm rõ ngắn, lịch sự và có thể hành động trong công việc.
learningObjectives: Xác nhận cách hiểu hiện tại

sections.title: Ambiguous ticket
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Ticket: Make the customer export faster and enterprise-ready by Friday. Current CSV exports contain up to 10,000 rows. The ticket does not specify a target duration, whether XLSX is in scope or who approves the benchmark.

expressions.meaning: Nêu cách hiểu hiện tại nhưng không biến nó thành sự thật đã được xác nhận.
expressions.example: My current understanding is that the Friday request covers CSV exports up to 10,000 rows.

expressions.meaning: Hỏi một success metric cụ thể và có thể đo được.
expressions.example: Could you confirm the target completion time for a 10,000-row CSV?
alternatives: What result should count as successful?

expressions.meaning: Kiểm tra một ranh giới phạm vi thay vì tự suy đoán.
expressions.example: Does the scope include XLSX exports, or CSV only?

expressions.phrase: Once these points are confirmed, I’ll ___.
expressions.meaning: Chốt bước tiếp theo để câu hỏi dẫn tới hành động.
expressions.example: Once these points are confirmed, I’ll define the benchmark and share an estimate.

exercises.question: Câu nào giúp nhóm ra quyết định nhanh nhất?
options: Before Friday, could you explain the whole ticket in more detail so that we all understand what the customer wants?
For the Friday release, should the benchmark use a 10,000-row CSV, what completion time should pass, and who approves the result?
Could you send the final requirements when they are ready, so that I can plan the work after the Friday release?
correctAnswer: For the Friday release, should the benchmark use a 10,000-row CSV, what completion time should pass, and who approves the result?
exercises.explanation: Câu hỏi dùng dữ kiện 10,000 rows hiện có và yêu cầu xác nhận target, scope cùng owner thay vì chỉ nói yêu cầu chưa rõ.

exercises.question: Câu mở đầu nào xác nhận cách hiểu mà không biến assumption thành fact?
options: My current understanding is that Friday covers CSV exports up to 10,000 rows; could you confirm?
The Friday scope is a 10,000-row CSV, so I will treat that as the approved benchmark and start the work today.
I understand that the export needs work; please add anything important that I missed.
correctAnswer: My current understanding is that Friday covers CSV exports up to 10,000 rows; could you confirm?
exercises.explanation: My current understanding báo hiệu đây là cách hiểu tạm thời và mời owner sửa nếu cần; hai lựa chọn còn lại hoặc khẳng định quá mức, hoặc quá mơ hồ để xác nhận.

exercises.question: Câu kết nào biến clarification thành một next action rõ ràng?
options: Once these points are confirmed, I’ll define the benchmark and share an estimate.
Once I hear back, I’ll read the ticket again, think about the export, and decide what the next steps could be.
I’ll begin implementation now and adjust later if the scope changes.
correctAnswer: Once these points are confirmed, I’ll define the benchmark and share an estimate.
exercises.explanation: Câu trả lời nêu chính xác việc người viết sẽ làm sau khi nhận xác nhận; hai lựa chọn còn lại thiếu deliverable hoặc bắt đầu trước khi scope rõ.

performanceTask.title: Send a clarification request
performanceTask.scenario: Bạn cần bắt đầu ticket nhưng acceptance criteria còn mơ hồ.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Viết tin nhắn hỏi lại mà chưa xem mẫu.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Viết bằng tiếng Anh một tin nhắn gồm cách hiểu hiện tại, hai câu hỏi cụ thể để xác nhận success metric, scope và owner, cùng bước bạn sẽ làm sau khi nhận câu trả lời.
performanceTask.modelResponse: My current understanding is that the Friday request covers customer exports, with CSV files currently reaching 10,000 rows. Could you confirm the target completion time and whether XLSX is in scope? Who should approve the benchmark? Once those points are confirmed, I’ll define the performance test and share an estimate.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Viết lại, tập trung vào tiêu chí chưa đạt và giữ tin nhắn dưới 100 từ.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Một API ticket nói 'improve reliability'. Hãy hỏi làm rõ success metric, phạm vi và owner.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Viết câu hỏi làm rõ cho một yêu cầu mới mà không xem lại model.

baseline.title: Enterprise export request
baseline.brief: Bạn chuẩn bị sprint planning. Xác nhận cách hiểu hiện tại, hỏi các tiêu chí còn thiếu và nêu bước sẽ làm sau khi product trả lời.

artifacts.title: Ticket EXP-214
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Make the customer export faster and enterprise-ready by Friday. Current CSV exports contain up to 10,000 rows. The ticket does not specify a target duration, whether XLSX is in scope or who approves the benchmark.

artifacts.title: Planning thread
artifacts.content:
Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Product: Enterprise customers mentioned exports in two calls.
Engineering: We can add a benchmark once the expected format and latency are confirmed.
Delivery lead: Friday is the requested date, but no approver is named.

retry.title: Partner webhook request
retry.brief: Sửa tin nhắn clarification cho partner demo: giữ giọng lịch sự, biến từ 'flaky' thành câu hỏi đo được và chốt next action.

artifacts.title: Ticket WEB-88
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Fix flaky webhook delivery before Tuesday's partner demo. The dashboard shows retries, but the request has no acceptable success rate, event types in scope or decision owner. The demo environment currently uses the standard retry policy.

artifacts.title: Team note
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Known deadline: Tuesday demo. Known environment: partner demo. Missing: reliability threshold, event scope, approver. Engineering can run a replay test after those points are confirmed.

transfer.title: API reliability request
transfer.brief: Unseen transfer: hỏi làm rõ success metric, phạm vi endpoint và owner mà không dùng lại dữ kiện export hoặc webhook.

artifacts.title: Ticket API-431
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Improve API reliability for the mobile launch next week. Recent alerts cover both authentication and profile endpoints, but the ticket does not define an error-rate target, launch-critical endpoints or the person who accepts the result.

artifacts.title: Launch channel
artifacts.content:
Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Mobile lead: We need a go/no-go signal by Thursday.
API team: We can compare the last seven days once the endpoint scope and acceptable failure rate are agreed.
Release coordinator: Acceptance owner is still open.

review.title: Audit-log retention request
review.brief: Delayed review: viết câu hỏi làm rõ mới từ memory của workflow, không xem lại model hay các response trước.

artifacts.title: Compliance request
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Make audit-log retention ready for regulated customers next sprint. Current retention is 30 days in the primary region. The request does not name the required retention period, whether replicas are included or who signs off on compliance.

artifacts.title: Security handoff
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Target window: next sprint. Current state: 30-day primary-region retention. Missing decisions: duration, regional scope, compliance approver. Platform can estimate storage cost after scope confirmation.

rubric.label: Current understanding
rubric.description: States a concrete interpretation instead of only saying it is unclear.

rubric.label: Specific questions
rubric.description: Asks for measurable scope, success signal or ownership.

rubric.label: Next action
rubric.description: Explains what will happen after clarification.
